thread:
Ana R.: :wave: quick kickoff — compliance sprint (SOC2/ISO) this week. High-level asks: 1) final owners for audit-log ingestion and retention mapping, 2) who will review the infra PR for KMS/HSM config, 3) sample evidence we should have ready for fieldwork. Tag owners pls.
Mike L.: I can take audit-log ingestion owner for staging -> prod. Will need list of log sources + retention table.
Jamal (infra): I can review the infra PR (repo: infra/security/kms). Ping me the PR link. Quick Q: are we moving to HSM-backed envelope keys or just KMS aliases for this sprint?
Sophia (compliance): @Mike L. thanks — retention table: we need mapping to controls (logs -> control IDs) and retention justification. I'll draft the template.
Prashant: For evidence, can we pre-generate a few sample rotated key attestations and KMS access logs for the auditors? I have a script that extracts signed events — can run in staging.
Ana R.: @Jamal let's aim for KMS aliases this sprint; HSM cutover is gated and needs vendor coord. Jamal can you call out the exact PR files that need review?
Jamal (infra): Sure — PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/412 (kms: alias+grant changes, auditlog agent config). Files: aws/kms.tf, services/audit-agent/config.yaml, docs/kms-rollover.md.
Mike L.: noted. I'll generate the retention table by EOD tomorrow and drop in the sprint board.
Sophia (compliance): @Prashant yes please run your script in staging and share the outputs in GH gist (redact sensitive ARNs). We'll attach that as sample evidence.
Prashant: Will do. Quick heads-up: the script needs a staging role with s3:GetObject on audit-bucket and kms:DescribeKey. I'll open a request ticket.
security-bot: Reminder: compliance-sprint channel created -> #compliance-sprint-169999. Auto-schedule: daily stand 10:30am.
Ana R.: Also need code review owners for docs: @sophia can you own docs verification for control mapping? @mike can you add the mapping file under docs/compliance/retention-mapping.csv?
Sophia (compliance): I can do docs verification. Small ask: can someone add a one-line example to the mapping CSV for audit-agent logs?
Jamal (infra): I'll add the CSV row and link the infra change.
Mike L.: Quick blocker: missing sample from legacy audit producer (old-db). @Ana R. can we deprioritize legacy for now or is evidence required?
Ana R.: Deprioritize legacy for this sprint — note in the board, but we'll capture as deferred risk.
Prashant: Opening ticket for staging role now -> TKT-893.
Sophia (compliance): I'll prepare the evidence checklist and post by tomorrow noon.
Ana R.: Thanks all. Action items: Mike -> retention table; Jamal -> PR reviews + CSV row; Prashant -> staging run + gist; Sophia -> checklist/docs. We'll reconvene async here; call if a blocker. :thumbsup:
